chapters.title: 1: Do you know my name? Perhaps you should forget it. I’m a wanted man.
2: Tick tock, damn it all. I don’t want to die today. Why am I still here?
3: Sing sweet nightingale. Angel voice and broken wings. None of us are free.
4: I’ll hold a vigil. Until the night surrenders. Then I’ll sail away.
5: I am a stranger. That’s what all the people say. No way I can hide.
6: Noble is the man. Who gives his life for others. Sadly, I’m not he.
7: When roses bloom in. The wintry snow then will my. Love return to me.
8: You think you know me. But you haven’t got a clue. I don’t know myself.
9: Take me home again. Never thought I’d see the day. O waly, waly.
10: Don’t dare look at you. Don’t know how to talk to you. We’ll just sit awhile.
11: In the Wild West. Every man is an outlaw. Or he wants to be
12: Oh to hell you ride. And home dissolves behind you. A paradise lost.
13: I’ll give you the moon. If you give me the morning. A world we will make.
14: I am never full. There’s a hole in my stomach. And one in my chest.
15: I will say I do. And mean it from the bottom. Of my crooked heart.
16: There is no leaving. I travel in a circle. Always Returning.
17: Tell me you love me. Even if it's not truth. I'll cherish the lie.
18: Opportunity. Dances past and laughs at me. Catch me if you can.
19: Where have you been, love? We are almost out of time. And I want to dance.
20: All I prayed for came. After my darkest hour. A son to heal me.
21: You make me believe. What my mother used to say. Some folks are just ours.
22: Time to catch a train. The whistle’s getting louder. Telling me to run.
23: You opened me up. And took my heart from my chest. Now how will I live?
24: Playing for money. Will never be the same as. Playing for our lives
25: I can’t hold on to. Anything good, and I can’t. Let go of the bad.
26: I can stop a train. Tie myself across the tracks. Just don’t say goodbye.
27: My love is not fine. Or made of silver and gold. But it’s all I have.
28: I too have felt the. Captive void of noble rage. Love has set me free.
29: If I look back now. I'll surely turn to salt, Lord. Keep my gaze forward.
Epilogue: Some say he died young. Many claim he grew quite old. No one really knows.
